content.text: Pick your plan. Stream your teams.This zip code is your Home Zip Code, which determines what content is available for you to stream. Your first stream must occur in your Home Zip Code. Please refer to our FAQs for more info.If a free trial is offered, the free trial is for new subscribers only. You acknowledge that you are purchasing a subscription for a regional package that only includes access to live games for the above - identified teams. Not all of those teams' games may be available. Access to content is not guaranteed and varies by your location at time of access and our ability to retrieve your location information. Regional restrictions and blackouts apply.
